text:
incident-bot: Paging: sev-2 - Tenant-specific model quality regression detected for tenant=acme-inc (dedicated pool)

sara: I got paged via oncall. brief recap -- QA alerts showing sudden drop in rouge/answer quality for their chat workloads starting ~08:07 UTC. Only shows up for their dedicated pool / quant profile.

mike_ml: seeing same. metrics: embedding similarity drop, increased hallucination flags from eval hooks. sample diffs attached in thread.

jin_runtime: Deploy bot shows quant-profile v1.3.2 applied to acme’s pool at 08:05 during rolling update. That profile is targeted to tenant.

alyssa_cs: Acme prod reported 'answers are incorrect/too short' via support ticket. They're in SSO'd VPC, high-priority customer. Coordinating comms.

nate_dedicated: Confirmed: dedicated pool rp-dedicated-08 used by acme. The quant profile was pushed via tenant-config service - command history: `POST /tenant-configs/acme/quant` by ci-pipeline at 08:05 UTC.

mike_ml: repro snippet (local eval against v1.3.2 vs v1.2.9):
```
prompt: "Summarize the refund policy for invoice 3487."
-> v1.2.9: "You can request refund within 30 days..."
-> v1.3.2: "Refunds not available."
```
this is a clear regression in extracted facts.

jin_runtime: Quick impact check: logs show ~1200 requests/min from acme, error/quality regressions at ~18% of responses flagged by our quality hooks since 08:06. No errors at infra level (no OOMs).

sara: Triage plan: 1) mitigate customer impact (fast rollback or bypass) 2) root cause (why quant profile caused semantic loss) 3) comms and postmortem.

mike_ml: Proposed immediate mitigation: revert acme tenant to previous quant-profile v1.2.9 and pin model variant to float-16 unquantized for their pool while we investigate. Reverting should be tenant-scoped and non-disruptive.

nate_dedicated: I can do tenant config rollback. Command to revert: `curl -X PUT https://config.redwood.internal/tenants/acme/quant -d '{"profile":"v1.2.9"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'` or via console -> Tenant configs -> rollback. Will schedule a canary to one host, then full.

sara: @nate go ahead with canary to 1 host, wait 2 minutes, then full rollback if metrics improve. Keep me posted every step.

deploy-bot: [deploy] quant-profile rollback job started by nate_dedicated -> job id: rollback-6221, targets: rp-dedicated-08-canary -> 08:22 UTC.

nate_dedicated: canary applied to host rp-dedicated-08-03 at 08:24 UTC. Monitoring...

mike_ml: while we wait: collecting model run-level traces and KV cache behavior. Hypothesis: new quant kernels changed attention head scaling for certain token ranges leading to factual drop. Also checking whether per-tenant prompt templates differ and amplify numeric rounding.

alyssa_cs: I've sent a proactive message to Acme CS contact letting them know we're investigating and attempting a rollback. No SLA escalation yet but they're watching.

nate_dedicated: canary looks good: quality hook drop to baseline within 30s for that host. Starting full rollback to pool (rp-dedicated-08) at 08:28 UTC. ETA ~40s to propagate.

incident-bot: [monitor] quality-hook anomaly rate for tenant=acme decreased from 18% -> 2% after rollback start.

sara: Good. Keep rollback running. Mike, after rollback, we need a safe revert plan to keep them on v1.2.9 until patch. Also capture minimal repro to run automated canaries before any tenant-targeted quant update.

mike_ml: Will run gradient-checks and sanity tests on v1.3.2 in our sandbox. Initial quick diff shows quantization scale mismatch for int8 per-channel vs per-tensor in last linear layer. Might cause large rounding errors for rare tokens.

jin_runtime: Note: this tenant uses custom tokenization mapping (legacy mapping). That likely amplified the change because v1.3.2 assumed newer token mapping for optimal calibration. Need to add mapping compatibility checks.

alyssa_cs: Customer update: "Thanks, appreciate the quick responses. Please confirm when fully rolled back and any expected follow-up."

nate_dedicated: rollback completed at 08:29:40 UTC. incident-bot confirms error rate back to baseline.

incident-bot: Incident severity update: degraded -> mitigated. No broader tenant impact.

sara: Action items captured:
- mike_ml: postmortem + root cause analysis (why v1.3.2 interacts badly with legacy token mapping), due EOD tomorrow.
- nate_dedicated: add per-tenant canary window and blocklist for auto-quant pushes to dedicated pools until signed off, done by EOD today.
- jin_runtime: add token-mapping compatibility check to quant-profile apply flow, PR by tomorrow.
- ops (sara): follow-up with CS for post-incident comms and check for any missed customer requests.

mike_ml: I'll attach the failing eval set and a small script to reproduce locally for engineering. Also will include suggested fix (per-channel calibration + guard rails).

alyssa_cs: I'll coordinate customer-facing notes and ask for any additional logs from Acme to help root cause.

sara: we'll keep this thread open until postmortem is posted. Great job team. :thumbsup:
